Bash(curl -s -X POST https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/ibnyclqobbrnjyxbbfsg/database/query -H 'Authorization: Bearer sbp_9066003bbff9ca579ed6e421b9c949ea26951980' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_user_school_id\(\)\\nRETURNS uuid\\nLANGUAGE plpgsql\\nSECURITY DEFINER\\nSTABLE\\nAS \\$\\$\\nDECLARE\\n  v_uid uuid := \(SELECT auth.uid\(\)\);\\n  v_school_id uuid;\\nBEGIN\\n  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;\\n\\n  -- Prefer the school the user explicitly selected this session\\n  SELECT uas.school_id INTO v_school_id\\n  FROM public.user_active_schools uas\\n  WHERE uas.user_id = v_uid\\n  AND \(\\n    EXISTS \(\\n      SELECT 1 FROM public.users u\\n      WHERE u.user_id = v_uid AND u.school_id = uas.school_id AND u.is_active = true\\n    \)\\n    OR\\n    EXISTS \(\\n      SELECT 1 FROM public.user_school_memberships usm\\n      WHERE usm.user_id = v_uid AND usm.school_id = uas.school_id AND usm.is_active = true\\n    \)\\n  \);\\n\\n  IF v_school_id IS NOT NULL THEN\\n    RETURN v_school_id;\\n  END IF;\\n\\n  -- Fallback: only one active membership exists, auto-select it \(backward compat\)\\n  SELECT u.school_id INTO v_school_id\\n  FROM public.users u\\n  WHERE u.user_id = v_uid AND u.is_active = true\\n  LIMIT 1;\\n\\n  RETURN v_school_id;\\nEND;\\n\\$\\$;"}')
